yamlCheck.dateAnchor: August 10 and the opening evening/6 p.m. are spoken. August 11 and 12 follow the two explicitly completed overnights; 1749 comes from YAML.
yamlCheck.explanation: The played interval begins at the August 10 return, covers the following day and two completed overnight rests, and ends pre-dawn on the resulting August 12. The opening recollection of three earlier days belongs to the previous strikes, not an additional played interval here. Forecast arrival times, spell durations not actually used up, and the next-session eight-round preparation window do not extend this span.
